# Buho Jump Full Reference

Canonical site: https://home.mybuho.de/jump/
Repository: https://github.com/Buho-Ecosystem/Buho-Jump
Issue tracker: https://github.com/Buho-Ecosystem/Buho-Jump/issues
License: AGPL-3.0-only
Authors: DoktorShift, Pratik227

## Product summary

Buho Jump is an open-source browser extension that brings together three pieces of functionality that are usually split across separate tools:

1. Nostr identity and signing
2. Bitcoin Lightning wallet connectivity
3. Encrypted messaging and group chat

The extension is designed to work as a browser-native companion for Nostr applications and any website that wants Nostr signing or WebLN payments.

## Primary features

- NIP-07 browser signer for Nostr apps
- NIP-46 remote signing with external signer apps
- WebLN provider for Lightning-enabled websites
- Nostr Wallet Connect wallet support
- Cashu wallet support
- Encrypted one-to-one messaging
- Private groups, relay communities, and open channels
- Multi-account support
- Multi-wallet support
- Per-site permissions and payment budgets
- Local encryption for stored secrets
- Multi-language interface

## Security and privacy model

- Private keys are encrypted at rest with AES-256-GCM
- Encryption keys are derived from the user password with PBKDF2
- Wallet connection strings are encrypted at rest
- Session unlock state is held in browser session storage
- The project states that it does not run analytics, telemetry, or tracking
- The project does not claim to operate backend servers that store user data

Users can choose between local key storage and external signing through NIP-46, which allows signatures to be approved by a separate signer app without the private key living inside the browser extension.

## Lightning model

Buho Jump can connect to Lightning wallets using Nostr Wallet Connect. It also exposes a WebLN provider so websites can request invoices and payments in a browser-native flow. The project positions this as a way to keep tipping, paywalls, zaps, and Lightning login flows inside the browser without app switching.

## Messaging model

Buho Jump supports encrypted direct messages and group-style communication on Nostr. The project documentation references NIP-17 gift wraps, NIP-44 encryption, NIP-04 fallback, NIP-29 relay communities, and NIP-28 open channels.

## Technical stack

- WXT
- Vue 3
- Tailwind CSS v4
- nostr-core
- Vitest

The repository structure centers on:

- `entrypoints/` for background, popup, prompt, and options pages
- `components/` for the Vue user interface
- `composables/` for shared reactive logic
- `lib/` for storage, crypto, wallets, relays, and protocol handling
- `locales/` for translations
- `blog/` for product and architecture articles

## Blog article guide

- `01-nip46-remote-signing` explains why external signers matter and how Buho Jump implements QR-based NIP-46 onboarding
- `02-why-another-nostr-extension` explains positioning against older signer-only extensions and wallet-only tools
- `03-your-keys-your-rules` explains local encryption and secret handling
- `04-lightning-in-your-browser` explains WebLN and NWC wallet setup
- `05-private-messaging` explains the messaging approach and supported chat modes
- `06-from-nos2x-to-buho` is the migration path for existing Nostr users
- `07-built-different` documents the architecture and engineering choices

## FAQ extract

Q: What is Buho Jump?
A: An open-source browser extension for Nostr identity, Lightning payments, and encrypted messaging.

Q: Does Buho Jump support remote signing?
A: Yes. It supports NIP-46 remote signing with external signer apps.

Q: Does Buho Jump support Lightning?
A: Yes. It supports WebLN and Nostr Wallet Connect wallets.

Q: Is Buho Jump open source?
A: Yes. The repository is public and licensed AGPL-3.0-only.

Q: Does Buho Jump collect analytics?
A: The documentation says no analytics, telemetry, or tracking are included.
